messages:
tara: heads-up: planning a base-image rebuild next Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC for CVE backports + seccomp tighten.

maria: +1. will RBAC changes for the image signer happen in the same window? want to avoid keystore privilege drift.

aj: suggestion: rotate keystore envelopes ahead of time. KMS says rotation is quick but consumers may need a grace pull.

kevin: oncall: add an incident-runbook stub. if staging fails image pull we should auto-fallback to old tag.

tara: fallback plan = policy-bound tags + deployer routing: on image_pull_fail -> pin :stable-old for 10m then alert.

maria: audit logging Q: will the rebuild spike registry reads? can our ingest and retention capture full pull traces for the window?

aj: tailer looks fine but I'll bump retention to 24h for the registry project: registry.audit.retention=24h.

maria: add a filter so tag/signature actions link to KMS op ids for post-cut forensics.

aj: sample filter: `resource.type="container_registry" AND protoPayload.method="google.cloud.storage.objects.get" AND labels.image_signed=true`.

kevin: vuln triage: glibc backport tested in staging. besides seccomp, consider dropping locales and removing non-essential /usr/bin tools. set CAP_DROP in runtime.

tara: agree, we'll produce a minimized artifact and document omitted binaries.

maria: RBAC PR: reduce signer role from signer.full -> signer.sign_create. I'll open PR to iam repo.

aj: note: staging attestation needs read scope for signer key metadata if role is tightened. will add to PR.

maria: KMS rotation schedule: if rotation overlaps rebuild, pause rotation 1h. can Platform Ops pause?

deploy-bot: deployment window confirmed: 2026-03-25T02:00Z -> 2026-03-25T05:00Z. canary = 10% for 15m.

kevin: ops can pause rotation. I'll create ticket and set pause=true 1h before window.

tara: checklist: 1) signer RBAC PR (maria) 2) retention + audit filters (aj) 3) pause keystore rotation (kevin) 4) minimized base build (tara) 5) canary + rollback (deploy-bot) 6) post-cut forensic runbook (maria).

maria: timeline: PRs by EOD Tue, infra staged Wed -4h, pause rotation 1h before. canary monitors: error_rate >0.5% OR p50 +200ms -> rollback.

aj: I'll add a health-check for cosign signature + KMS op id: `curl -s $REGISTRY/api/v1/images/$TAG/signature | jq .kmsOpId`.

kevin: I'll be oncall. if pager fires, tag @kevin and incident-runbook. :thumbsup:

tara: thanks all. I'll create staging thread and link the runbook here. ping for blockers. :wave:
